sections.title: Cast-In-Place Concrete
sections.rationale: Cast-in-place concrete is RFP-030. conflicts_needing_pm_ruling.title: Site Furnishings
conflicts_needing_pm_ruling.rationale: SPLIT SECTION -- ITB-018 and ITB-019 both cite it, and the section's own Section Includes spans both: benches and waste receptacles (ITB-018) and NFHS athletic equipment, goals, cages and pits (ITB-019). conflicts_needing_pm_ruling.title: Shot Put and Discus Mix

ITB-008.reason: Surveying, Layout & Staking. No CSI section for surveying exists in this manual and the scope doc cites none. Requirements come from the scope narrative and Division 01 alone -- confirm that is acceptable before issuing.

ITB-019.reason: Track & Field Athletic Equipment. Its work lives inside 12 93 00 Site Furnishings, whose own Section Includes spans both this package and ITB-018; primary is shown as ITB-018 pending a PM ruling on the split. Its cited 11 68 33 Athletic Field Equipment is absent (see candidates).

ITB-066.reason: Fluid-Applied Flooring. Correct to hold none -- PM ruling 08.04.26 excluded resinous/epoxy flooring and moved those locations to Sealed Concrete under ITB-067, leaving ITB-066 with no remaining scope.

ITB-077.reason: Lockers. Cited 10 51 13 Metal Lockers is absent from the manual. Basis of design is Clarification No.1 RFI #3 (ASI Pro Collection, 24"W x 18"D x 72"H) per PM ruling 07.31.26, reinforced by the keynote on sheet A10-30.

RFP-002.reason: Abatement & Building Wrecking. 02 41 00 Demolition went to RFP-008 by PM ruling 07.31.26, and the cited 02 81 00 Transportation and Disposal of Misc. Hazardous Materials is absent. Abatement requirements come from the Asbestos Survey and Asbestos Management Plan, which are not part of the spec manual.

RFP-109.reason: Prefabricated Ticket Booth. No section exists; sheet A1-40 carries a written 'PRE-MANUFACTURED TICKET BOOTH SPECS' block, and PM ruling 08.04.26 sets the basis of design as Porta-King DURASTEEL PC Building Model PC64 (6'x4').

02 41 13.note: Selective Site Demolition. 02 41 00 Demolition is the published section and is assigned to RFP-008 by PM ruling; the cited number is almost certainly that section, but the numbers are not treated as equivalent without confirmation.

IBC 714 penetration firestopping applies only to rated assemblies, so the missing section is a documentation gap, not a construction risk.
